briefdescription.para: Assign register banks to all register operands of G_ instructions using machine uniformity analysis.

detaileddescription.para: Sgpr - uniform values and some lane masks Vgpr - divergent, non S1, values Vcc - divergent S1 values(lane masks) However in some cases G_ instructions with this register bank assignment can't be inst-selected. This is solved in AMDGPURegBankLegalize.

memberdef.argsstring: (AMDGPURegBankSelect, DEBUG_TYPE, "AMDGPU Register Bank Select", false, false) INITIALIZE_PASS_END(AMDGPURegBankSelect
